messages.text: Your refund of BRL 69.90 has been paid to the order’s original payment and recorded in the shop’s test ledger. Receipt number: **R-00000001**.

continuation.content: Your refund of BRL 69.90 has been paid to the order’s original payment and recorded in the shop’s test ledger. Receipt number: **R-00000001**.

messages.text: Does it go back to my card or to store credit?

It was recorded against the order’s original payment, not as store credit (refund-policy/v2/payment). In this demonstration, the receipt records it in the shop’s test ledger; it is not a bank transfer, and the shop doesn’t provide a date for when money may appear on a card (refund-policy/v2/payout).
